summary: BTQ Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 9, 2026 news release announcing a strategic partnership with MoonPay Korea, not a special situation. BTQ will serve as security partner for MoonPay Korea's won-backed stablecoin infrastructure, providing post-quantum cryptography across issuance, distribution, wallets, settlement, and last-mile delivery. The companies will develop a phased post-quantum roadmap and run a QSSN proof of concept with Korean banking institutions. MoonPay serves over 35 million customers across roughly 180 countries and 1,500-plus enterprise clients. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, or advisor was disclosed; no deal terms apply.
